items.name: Taking Inventory
items.requirement: Open your inventory.

items.name: Getting Wood
items.requirement: Collect a block of wood from a tree.

items.name: Benchmaking
items.requirement: Craft a Crafting Table using four wooden planks.

items.name: Time to Mine!
items.requirement: Craft a pickaxe using wooden planks and sticks.

items.name: Hot Topic
items.requirement: Craft a furnace.

items.name: Acquire Hardware
items.requirement: Smelt an iron ingot.

items.name: Time to Farm!
items.requirement: Craft a hoe.

items.name: Bake Bread
items.requirement: Turn wheat into bread.

items.name: The Lie
items.requirement: Bake a cake using wheat, sugar, milk and eggs.

items.name: Getting an Upgrade
items.requirement: Upgrade your pickaxe to a better material.

items.name: Delicious Fish
items.requirement: Catch and cook a fish.

items.name: On A Rail
items.requirement: Travel by minecart for at least 500 blocks in a straight line.

items.name: Time to Strike!
items.requirement: Craft a sword.

items.name: Monster Hunter
items.requirement: Kill a hostile monster.

items.name: Cow Tipper
items.requirement: Collect leather.

items.name: When Pigs Fly
items.requirement: Ride a pig using a saddle and have it take fall damage.

items.name: Sniper Duel
items.requirement: Kill a skeleton from at least 50 blocks away using a projectile.

items.name: DIAMONDS!
items.requirement: Obtain diamonds using an iron or better pickaxe.

items.name: Into the Nether
items.requirement: Build, light and enter a Nether portal.

items.name: Return to Sender
items.requirement: Kill a Ghast using its own fireball.

items.name: Into Fire
items.requirement: Obtain a blaze rod.

items.name: Local Brewery
items.requirement: Brew a potion.

items.name: The End?
items.requirement: Enter the End dimension.

items.name: The End
items.requirement: Defeat the Ender Dragon.

items.name: Enchanter
items.requirement: Craft an Enchanting Table.

items.name: Overkill
items.requirement: Deal at least 9 hearts of damage with a single hit.

items.name: Librarian
items.requirement: Build bookshelves for an Enchanting Table.

items.name: Adventuring Time
items.requirement: Discover at least 17 different biomes.

items.name: The Beginning?
items.requirement: Summon the Wither.

items.name: The Beginning.
items.requirement: Defeat the Wither.

items.name: The Beaconator
items.requirement: Create and fully power a Beacon.

items.name: Repopulation
items.requirement: Breed two cows using wheat.

items.name: Diamonds to you!
items.requirement: Throw a diamond to another player.

items.name: Overpowered
items.requirement: Eat an Enchanted Golden Apple.

items.name: MOAR Tools
items.requirement: Construct one of each type of tool.

items.name: Dispense With This
items.requirement: Craft a Dispenser.

items.name: Leader of the Pack
items.requirement: Tame five wolves.

items.name: Pork Chop
items.requirement: Cook and eat a porkchop.

items.name: Passing the Time
items.requirement: Play for 100 in-game days.

items.name: The Haggler
items.requirement: Acquire or spend 30 emeralds by trading.

items.name: Pot Planter
items.requirement: Craft and place a flower pot.

items.name: It's a Sign!
items.requirement: Craft and place a sign.

items.name: Iron Belly
items.requirement: Use Rotten Flesh to restore hunger when near starvation.

items.name: Have a Shearful Day
items.requirement: Use shears to obtain wool from a sheep.

items.name: Rainbow Collection
items.requirement: Collect all 16 wool colors.

items.name: Stayin' Frosty
items.requirement: Walk through lava while protected by Fire Resistance.

items.name: Chestful of Cobblestone
items.requirement: Mine 1,728 cobblestone and place it in a chest.

items.name: Renewable Energy
items.requirement: Smelt wood logs using charcoal as fuel.

items.name: Body Guard
items.requirement: Create an Iron Golem.

items.name: Iron Man
items.requirement: Wear a full set of iron armor.

items.name: Zombie Doctor
items.requirement: Cure a Zombie Villager.

items.name: Lion Hunter
items.requirement: Obtain a cat as a tamed companion.

items.name: Archer
items.requirement: Kill a Creeper using a bow and arrows.

items.name: Tie Dye Outfit
items.requirement: Dye every piece of leather armor.

items.name: Trampoline
items.requirement: Bounce at least 30 blocks upward from a slime block.

items.name: Camouflage
items.requirement: Kill a mob while wearing the matching mob head.

items.name: Map Room
items.requirement: Place nine fully explored maps in item frames in a connected map display.

items.name: Freight Station
items.requirement: Use a hopper to move an item from a Chest Minecart into a chest.

items.name: Smelt Everything!
items.requirement: Connect three chests to a furnace using hoppers.

items.name: Taste of Your Own Medicine
items.requirement: Poison a Witch using a splash potion.

items.name: Inception
items.requirement: Push a piston using another piston and retract the original piston.

items.name: Saddle Up
items.requirement: Tame a horse.

items.name: Artificial Selection
items.requirement: Breed a mule from a horse and donkey.

items.name: Free Diver
items.requirement: Stay underwater for two minutes.

items.name: Rabbit Season
items.requirement: Cook and eat rabbit meat.

items.name: The Deep End
items.requirement: Defeat an Elder Guardian.

items.name: Dry Spell
items.requirement: Dry a wet sponge in a furnace.

items.name: Super Fuel
items.requirement: Use a lava bucket as furnace fuel.

items.name: You Need a Mint
items.requirement: Collect a dragon's breath.

items.name: Beam Me Up
items.requirement: Teleport more than 100 blocks using an Ender Pearl.

items.name: The End... Again...
items.requirement: Respawn the Ender Dragon.

items.name: Great View From Up Here
items.requirement: Levitate at least 50 blocks from attacks by a Shulker.

items.name: Super Sonic
items.requirement: Fly through a 1x1 opening at very high speed using an Elytra.

items.name: Treasure Hunter
items.requirement: Acquire a map from a Cartographer and use it to find the indicated structure.

items.name: Organizational Wizard
items.requirement: Name a Shulker Box using an Anvil.

items.name: Cheating Death
items.requirement: Use a Totem of Undying to survive otherwise fatal damage.

items.name: Feeling Ill
items.requirement: Defeat an Evoker.

items.name: Let It Go!
items.requirement: Walk across a frozen ocean using Frost Walker boots.

items.name: So I Got That Going for Me
items.requirement: Lead a caravan containing at least five llamas.

items.name: Atlantis?
items.requirement: Find an underwater ruin.

items.name: Sail the 7 Seas
items.requirement: Visit all ocean biomes.

items.name: Castaway
items.requirement: Eat only dried kelp for three in-game days.

items.name: Ahoy!
items.requirement: Discover a Shipwreck.

items.name: I am a Marine Biologist
items.requirement: Collect a fish in a bucket.

items.name: Me Gold!
items.requirement: Dig up buried treasure.

items.name: Sleep with the Fishes
items.requirement: Spend a full Minecraft day underwater.

items.name: Alternative Fuel
items.requirement: Use a dried kelp block as furnace fuel.

items.name: Do a Barrel Roll!
items.requirement: Use Riptide to launch yourself.

items.name: One Pickle, Two Pickle, Sea Pickle, Four
items.requirement: Place four sea pickles in one block.

items.name: Echolocation
items.requirement: Feed a dolphin so it leads you toward treasure.

items.name: Moskstraumen
items.requirement: Activate a Conduit.

items.name: Top of the World
items.requirement: Place scaffolding at the world height limit.

items.name: Where Have You Been?
items.requirement: Receive a notification from a tamed cat.

items.name: Zoologist
items.requirement: Breed two pandas using bamboo.

items.name: Fruit on the Loom
items.requirement: Create a banner using an Enchanted Apple pattern.

items.name: Plethora of Cats
items.requirement: Befriend twenty stray cats.

items.name: Kill the Beast!
items.requirement: Defeat a Ravager.

items.name: Buy Low, Sell High
items.requirement: Trade for the best possible price.

items.name: Disenchanted
items.requirement: Use a Grindstone to remove an enchantment and gain experience.

items.name: We're being attacked!
items.requirement: Trigger a Pillager Raid.

items.name: Sound the Alarm!
items.requirement: Ring a village bell after a villager has been hurt.

items.name: I've got a bad feeling about this
items.requirement: Kill a Pillager Captain.

items.name: Master Trader
items.requirement: Trade for 1,000 emeralds.

items.name: Time for Stew
items.requirement: Give another player suspicious stew.

items.name: Bee our guest
items.requirement: Use a campfire to collect honey from a beehive with a bottle without angering the bees.

items.name: Total Beelocation
items.requirement: Move a bee nest containing three bees using Silk Touch.

items.name: Sticky Situation
items.requirement: Use a honey block to slow a fall.

items.name: Bullseye
items.requirement: Hit the bullseye of a target block from at least 30 blocks away.

items.name: Cover Me in Debris
items.requirement: Obtain a complete set of Netherite armor.

items.name: Oooh, shiny!
items.requirement: Distract a Piglin with gold.

items.name: Hot Tourist Destination
items.requirement: Visit all Nether biomes.

items.name: Whatever Floats Your Goat!
items.requirement: Float in a boat with a goat.

items.name: Wax On
items.requirement: Apply honeycomb to a copper block.

items.name: Wax Off
items.requirement: Remove wax from a copper block.

items.name: The Healing Power of Friendship!
items.requirement: Form a friendship with an Axolotl and help it win a fight.

items.name: Caves & Cliffs
items.requirement: Fall from the top of the world to the bottom while surviving.

items.name: Star Trader
items.requirement: Trade with a villager at the world height limit.

items.name: Sound of Music
items.requirement: Make a jukebox play music in a meadow biome.

items.name: Feels Like Home
items.requirement: Take a Strider for a long ride across a lava lake in the Overworld.

items.name: It Spreads
items.requirement: Kill a mob near a Sculk Catalyst so the catalyst spreads sculk.

items.name: Birthday Song
items.requirement: Have an Allay drop a cake at a note block.

items.name: With Our Powers Combined!
items.requirement: Have all three types of froglights in your inventory.

items.name: Sneak 100
items.requirement: Sneak beside a Sculk Sensor without triggering it.

items.name: Planting the past
items.requirement: Plant a Sniffer seed.

items.name: Careful restoration
items.requirement: Create a Decorated Pot using four pottery sherds.

items.name: Smithing with style
items.requirement: Apply the Spire, Snout, Rib, Ward, Silence, Vex, Tide and Wayfinder armor trim templates at least once.

items.name: Crafters Crafting Crafters
items.requirement: Be nearby when a Crafter crafts another Crafter.

items.name: Who Needs Rockets?
items.requirement: Use a Wind Charge to launch yourself upward at least 8 blocks.

items.name: Over-Overkill
items.requirement: Deal at least 50 hearts of damage with one Mace hit.

items.name: Revaulting
items.requirement: Unlock an Ominous Vault using an Ominous Trial Key.

items.name: Heart Transplanter
items.requirement: Place a Creaking Heart correctly aligned between two Pale Oak Log blocks.

items.name: Stay Hydrated!
items.requirement: Place a Dried Ghast block into water.

items.name: Mob Kabob
items.requirement: Hit five mobs with one charged Spear attack.

items.name: Uh-oh.
items.requirement: Have a Sulfur Cube absorb a TNT block.
